reviews.title: Thick Strong Vinyl
reviews.review_text: Thicker than similarly priced vinyl I've purchased from different retailers. The thickness might be the reason weeding seems to be a problem for others. I used "more pressure" rather than "default" on Cricut's Design Space to make sure the cut was clean. I feel like mil should be a spec for vinyl. The vinyl will stretch before tearing. The reverse backing has 1/2" grid on it for straight and measured cutting with scissors. Overall, will purchase again.

reviews.title: Difficult weeding on a smaller scale
reviews.review_text: It was difficult to weed on a smaller scale. While I have not tried it on a larger scale, it does seem like it has worked for other people.
